wire.encoding: UTF-8 JSON object per LF-delimited frame

identity.trusted: Mac owner and same-user processes, UTM/Apple VZ, guest root and broker; no shared hosting

sequence.effect: Exclusively persist consumed-attempt record and fsync its directory before starting runtime barrier; tool stays inactive.

control_channel.uncertain_write_or_lost_ack: Never resend prepare/grant/heartbeat/stop as an execution command; close execution channel and use fixed inspection/owner stop for reconciliation.

pty_open_requirements: User supplies both displayed PTY paths for the exact once-started VM
Correlate package UUID, signed app executable/PID/start time and VZ process/open handles
lstat character device with expected owner/mode and recorded rdev/inode; no symlink; open with nofollow and compare fstat

Save raw terminal settings and restore only the same live device identity; close own fd on exit
Correlate startup hello/boot ID; a nonce is correlation only and never replaces host-owner trust
fd_policy: Controller and guest broker close all unneeded inherited descriptors; runtime/tool get only intended stdio/journal, never host paths, PTYs, management sockets or provider stores.
required_offline_regressions: multiple complete frames without false overflow
PTY symlink/rdev/owner swap and competing consumer
repeated grant and consumed record after restart
slow inspection cannot renew runtime lease
normal stop and uncertainty when independent cleanup cannot be proven
pty_permission_mismatch: Stop; never chmod/chown or broaden to group/world access.
